So here are few things we added in this update:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with saves
[*] Fixed issue with in-game menu

[*] Radio mini-game remastered

[*] Added new animations and visual effects

If you have any issues or suggestions don't hesistate to contact us! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New rules for exchanging DLC key
notes.notes:
To receive your DLC key instead of old key you must send me a screenshot to email sergey@play-cute.com

Screenshot should contain:

Your Steam name
List of several your games in steam
Varenje in it and date of activation

Thank you!

We have a lot of fraudsters...

notes.title: Exchange DLC key
notes.notes:
Hey 

There are a lot of fraud attempts for DLC keys.
So please follow these rules to get your DLC key instead of Demo key:

Please send me the key or screenshot with activation date of the game and 8 other your games near Varenje(4 upper and 4 lower).

Do not try to get DLC key twice or more from other emails. We will deactive DLC key that was sent previously. 

To fraudsters: we collect every key that we received and every screenshot. So please don't try to fool us. You just wasting our and other players time. We have a lot of keys requests so it's very hard to send it in time.

Thank you!

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We are sorry for delay :(
We are trying to make the game available on Steam as soon as possible. 

To be clear - the game is ready. We gave it to our publisher few weeks ago.

Right now the publisher and Valve are negotiating about releae date.
So it depends only on them when the game will be published on Steam.

Don't worry, it will not take too long.

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Game release on 14th of June
notes.notes:

We need some quick fixes to do.
